name: potsherd
description: Rescue, index, search, interrogate and re-enter every coding-agent session on your machine. Indexes each Codex thread as it ends, and exposes the whole archive over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and recall retained coding-agent sessions
interface.longDescription: potsherd keeps a local, searchable archive of every coding-agent session on your machine and answers questions over it. This plugin indexes each Codex thread as it ends and exposes the archive to Codex over MCP.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about the connection pooler last month?
